d: This role leads pre-sales strategy, deployment governance, and enterprise platform positioning to ensure alignment between sales, delivery capacity, and scalable implementation models. It defines deployment standards across environments, establishes readiness criteria, and drives consistent, repeatable execution across global customer engagements. The position owns portfolio-level delivery performance, risk management, and strategic account health, ensuring measurable ROI and long-term customer success. It also builds and scales the technical operating model, partners with product and engineering leadership, and drives continuous improvement through metrics, insights, and industry leaders.
In a rapidly growing software company, this is a crucial leadership position requiring multi-talented individuals. This position will report directly to the Chief Customer Officer.
q: Proven track record of balancing enterprise revenue growth with delivery risk, regulatory exposure, and long-term trust
Demonstrated experience and understanding of global enterprise operating environments
Has successfully led and managed leaders
Defining strategy, accountability and organizational structure
Comfortable scaling engagement and operations globally
Portfolio level understanding of enterprise cloud ecosystems, security and compliance constraints, deployment frameworks and large-scale data integration architectures
Exceptional written, presentation, and verbal communication skills
An ability to explain technical subjects to non-technical people
Experience with enterprise software implementations involving complex data integration and migration efforts

Experience in oil & gas operating facilities (upstream, midstream, or downstream) with the ability to thoroughly understand operational challenges and communicate effectively with customer personnel across functions and levels
Project Management and/or Agile certification is a plus
Experience with the Atlassian suite of management tools preferred

Customer Engagement and Account Health Ownership

Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to incorporate real world enterprise deployment learnings into roadmap prioritization

Context Labs is collaborative at its core. You’ll work within your team and across the organization allowing for continuous learning and discovery.
We set goals that matter and provide value in all that we do, from building meaningful products to positively impacting carbon reduction and climate change.

x: Context Labs is dedicated to sourcing, organizing, and contextualizing the world’s climate information. The company enables data to become trusted, shared, and utilized as Asset Grade Data (AGD™), providing insights and solutions to inform markets. Context Labs mission is to provide the world’s trusted data fabric platform, delivering Asset Grade Data to customers using the Immutably™ Enterprise Data Fabric platform, deploying machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, and cryptographic blockchain technologies, for context-driven insights.

Building on the Immutably™ Enterprise Data Fabric platform, the company has deployed Decarbonization-as-a-Service™ (DaaS™), which is tailored to accelerate the Global Energy Transition by providing trusted emissions performance data, and its CLEAR Path™ platform to enable customers to optimize value creation with independently certified carbon intensity for their products and services. The company was formed out of MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) research and is comprised of a leadership team that has been instrumental in the at-scale growth of the Internet, in prior companies. The company has offices in Amsterdam (Netherlands), Cambridge (Massachusetts), and Houston (Texas).
